help.title: Help & support
help.faq.free_call.q: How does the free daily call work?
help.faq.free_call.a: Each account gets one free call per day to a business account. After that, the call is deducted from your credit balance.
help.faq.credit_pack.q: How do I buy a credit pack?
help.faq.credit_pack.a: From your Profile, in the “Credit balance” section, tap “Buy a pack” and pay with Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money or card.
help.faq.hidden_number.q: Why can't I see the merchant's number?
help.faq.hidden_number.a: NetBuis never shows the number. However, your phone may show it during the call and keep it in its call log. On iPhone, the system asks for a confirmation that shows the number.
help.faq.create_business.q: How do I create my business account?
help.faq.create_business.a: From your Profile, tap “Activate my Business account”, then choose the type that fits your situation: Shop, Company, Venue, Individual seller or Service provider.
help.faq.pending.a: The NetBuis team checks every application (photos, information) before activation, to protect users from fake accounts. It usually takes a few hours to a day.
help.faq.product_limit.q: How many products can I add?
help.faq.product_limit.q.credits: How many products can I add without a subscription?
help.faq.product_limit.a.credits: Up to 3 subcategories/products per sector without a subscription. A subscription unlocks unlimited selection, display priority and unlimited posts.
help.faq.join_team.q: How do I become a member of the NetBuis team?
help.faq.join_team.a: Apply from the app: personal information + a video of your ID card. Once approved, you receive a personal QR code to refer business accounts.
help.faq.sponsorship.a: A merchant you refer scans your QR code and signs up on their own. Once their account is validated, a bonus is credited to your referral balance.
help.faq.report_suspect.q: How do I report a suspicious account?
help.faq.report_suspect.a: Use the “Report a problem or a suspicious account” button below, or contact support directly.
